irregularities.title: Implied effective tax rates in the client's tax history exceed official rates
irregularities.detail: Property A 2025: $7,207 / $539,743 assessed = 1.335%. Sampled official TRA totals (S06) run 1.1258%-1.2409%. Property B 2025: $2,439 / $114,248 = 2.135%, versus the SF FY 2026-27 secured rate of 1.18162182% (S07). Possible causes: direct charges, special assessments, or a different value. Reconcile with the actual bills before relying on the history.

irregularities.title: Prop 19 covers only an owner-occupied unit in a multi-unit building
irregularities.detail: BOE LTA 2026/026 says each unit of a multi-unit property must qualify separately. Two rented units cannot use the family-home exclusion. Model reassesses the rented portion to market value.

irregularities.title: Prop 19 treatment requires the parent's principal residence at the time of transfer
irregularities.detail: Projections assume the decedent's principal residence status for Property A and the owner-occupied unit of B. If this is not so, a full reassessment to market value applies.

irregularities.title: ACC Plus eligibility wording conflicts across sources
irregularities.detail: PG&E tariff text (S24) says ACC Plus is for customers interconnecting during the first five years of the tariff. A secondary source says the window closes around end of 2027. The final decision text was not fetched. Treat as unresolved; do not rely on ACC Plus in projections.

irregularities.title: Solar 'profit' of $10-20/mo is a bill credit, not guaranteed cash income
irregularities.detail: Under net billing, exports are credited at ACC values (S24) and non-bypassable charges still apply to imports. The model treats the client figure as a credit. Verify with PG&E/SVCE statements.

irregularities.title: Third-party article attributes the H.R. 1301 Death Tax Repeal Act to a Senate leader; congress.gov lists a House sponsor
irregularities.detail: congress.gov (S27) lists Rep. Randy Feenstra as sponsor, introduced 02/13/2025. Attribution in the secondary article is not supported by congress.gov. Use congress.gov.

irregularities.title: Cupertino and SF city-level transfer taxes not verified
irregularities.detail: No official rate page fetched for SF city transfer tax (third-party tiers conflict) or Cupertino city transfer tax. Left blank. Sale scenarios exclude these taxes.

irregularities.title: Cupertino TRA composite not located
irregularities.detail: The parcel's TRA composite rate was not found in the rate-book pages reviewed. Projections use a planning midpoint (1.18%) and flag the uncertainty.

irregularities.title: Cupertino sewer and stormwater charges not verified
irregularities.detail: Cupertino sewer provider and rate not verified. City stormwater fee page exists (S33) but the amount was not confirmed.

irregularities.title: Rent-control coverage of rented units not verified
irregularities.detail: Rent Board 1.6% cap applies only to covered units (S25). Coverage depends on construction date and exemptions; not verified for this building.

irregularities.title: Insurance premiums are client estimates; no official average found
irregularities.detail: CDI (S30) provides tools but no published average premium for Cupertino or SF on the page reviewed. $1,500/yr is a client estimate, unverified.

irregularities.title: Client electricity and water ranges not reconciled to utility bills
irregularities.detail: Water: 10 ccf/month at SJW tariff = $138.13 (within the client's $100-150 range). SF electricity rates not verified.

irregularities.title: Small rounding differences in client assessed-value percentages
irregularities.detail: Cupertino 2021 assessed value shows +1% while the values imply +1.04%. SF 2021 shows +1% and the values imply +1.04%.

irregularities.title: Pending SJW general rate case: proposed future rates not approved
irregularities.detail: CPUC application shows proposed quantity charges for 2028-2031 (S34). Not used in projections.

irregularities.title: SFPUC multi-family water (W-1B) applies per dwelling unit; meter type unknown
irregularities.detail: Client water range ($330-400/mo) is used as an input; tariff rates shown for reference only.

irregularities.title: Federal portability election and state probate thresholds not verified
irregularities.detail: Not included as verified values. Confirm with an estate attorney.

irregularities.title: Federal and California 2026 values: CA 2026 bracket schedule not fetched
irregularities.detail: Only the 2025 FTB schedule was verified (S17). Not used as a verified 2026 value.

irregularities.title: Two analyses in this repository disagree on some results
irregularities.detail: The root site (session c1b5796b, merged with PR #4) and the docs/ analysis (session 340c906c) use different assumptions from this guide. Examples: the root site's headline says selling is the strongest plan for both properties; this guide says selling beats holding Property A and that the Property B result is close in the base case. The 2045 Property A tax and break-even rent also differ. Do not combine the figures. Reconcile the assumptions before relying on any single number.
